descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are expanding our operations team to support our growing customer base. In this role, you will manage, support, and continuously improve customer IT infrastructure, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 and Azure.
 You will provide 2nd and 3rd level support, troubleshoot complex infrastructure and user issues, and act as a trusted technical partner for customer IT teams. Beyond resolving requests, you will actively identify patterns, inefficiencies, and recurring issues, and translate them into improvements, automation opportunities, and more scalable support processes.
 You will also serve as a manual resolution layer for 1st level requests, ensuring that end-user needs are effectively addressed when automated or AI-driven workflows cannot fully resolve them—while continuously helping reduce this gap through smarter automation and better design.
 This role combines hands-on support with a strong advisory and operational mindset, helping customers build more stable, secure, and efficient environments over time.
 What you’ll do: 
Provide L1/L2/L3 support across Microsoft 365, Azure, users, devices, and servers
Administer M365 services (Entra ID, Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, licensing, user lifecycle)
Support Azure infrastructure (VMs, identity, networking basics, access, monitoring)
Assist with server operations and hybrid environments
Provide endpoint & device support (Intune, Windows, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting)
Work directly with customers and end users to resolve issues and improve operations
Identify recurring issues and propose improvements, automation, and governance enhancements
Collaborate with internal teams to optimize support processes and build AI Agents and agentic flows
 Who you are: 
Experience in IT support, cloud operations, or system administration
Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and user management
Hands-on experience with Azure infrastructure fundamentals
Good understanding of Entra ID, access management, and security basics
Experience with endpoint/device management (Intune is a plus)
Strong troubleshooting mindset and structured problem-solving skills
Comfortable working with customers and explaining solutions clearly
Familiar with PowerShell or automation tools
Bonus: experience with Dynamics 365 (F&O / CRM) or Power Platform
Relevant certifications (AZ-104, MS-102, etc.) are a plus
 What we offer: 
Work from wherever you feel productive (full remote is an option), own your own schedule.
An engineering culture focused on proficiency (praised by technology partners & customers alike), in which you can further develop your skills as a professional.
Career growth opportunities brought by the company’s fast paced growth
Support for your learning efforts through trainings, R&D projects, certifications and knowledge sharing.
Work with innovative technology, combining cloud-based automation and integration with AI Agents.
Informal leadership style and a relaxed working environment, without compromising engineering rigor.
Premium Medical subscription.
 Hiring Process: 
 We are swift in our decision-making and aim to keep the process efficient:
General Aptitude Test (50m): A first-step assessment designed to evaluate your problem-solving abilities, critical and computational thinking and technical knowledge.
Alignment Call (30m-60m): A discussion to align on expectations, culture, and your career goals.
Technical Assessment(60-90m): A practical, hands-on evaluation of your skills in Azure architecture and M365 configuration.
 This position is only available via employment contract (CIM).
